name: クランクシャフト

pages.text: A $(thing)Crankshaft$() is a way of turning $(l:mechanics/mechanical_power)Rotational Power$() into $(thing)Moving-back-and-forth Power$(). This can be useful in order to power devices such as the $(l:metalworking/bellows)Bellows$(), or $(l:mechanics/pumps)Water Pumps$().$(br2)The $(thing)Crankshaft$() consists of two parts: the base, and the shaft. The base must be connected to an $(l:mechanics/mechanical_power#axle)Axle$(), and devices can be connected to the end of the shaft.
$(thing)軸$()によって動力を供給される$(l:mechanics/mechanical_power#axle)クランクシャフト$()
ベースは$(l:getting_started/primitive_alloys#brass)真鍮$()から作成できます。ベースが設置されたら、$(thing)鋼の棒$()を使用してシャフトを追加できます。クランクシャフトの横に空きスペースがある場合、棒が配置されます。

The crankshaft can be connected to a $(l:metalworking/bellows)Bellows$() by placing one adjacent to the shaft. This will then push automatically every time the shaft extends then contracts. When connected to a crankshaft it cannot be operated manually.$(br2)The crankshaft can also be connected to a $(l:mechanics/pumps)Pump$(), which can be used to transport fluids.
